description: DiligenceOps: submit a status page (text, or a public HTTPS url). The signed report lists the uptime figures and whether each states a reporting window (past 90 days, this month, a date range), the incident and maintenance entries with their dates and status words, and the most recent entry with its date and days before the check. POST /api/status-evidence-check. Reads the supplied text, or one public HTTPS page read once with GET (no redirects, public DNS only, 512 KB): no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-evidence-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

inputSchema.description: Send exactly one of text or url.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

label.description: Optional name for the page, recorded in the report.

text.description: The status as plain text, Markdown or HTML, up to 256 KB.

url.description: A public HTTPS status page, read once with GET, no redirects, up to 512 KB.

name: wever_status-evidence-check
title: Status evidence check
